title: Leo and Fern Make a Plan
markdown:
Sunbeams danced into Leo's room. "Science club today!" he bounced. Fern the fawn trotted in. "Super Snack Sandwiches needed!" she chimed. "For our experiment! Extra-special!"

Leo grabbed bread. "Cheese first!" Fern grabbed jam. "This on top!" Squish! Jam splattered! A sticky mess!

"Oh dear," Fern whispered, ears drooping. Leo's fast ideas couldn't fix it.

"We need a plan," said Aunt Rosa, her voice warm. She took paper and a crayon. "A special order for each step. What comes FIRST?"

Leo tapped his chin. "Bottom bread!"

"Yes!" Aunt Rosa wrote. "Step one: Bottom bread. Then?"

"Then cheese!" Fern's eyes lit up.

"Brilliant!" Aunt Rosa wrote. "Step two: Cheese. After that?"

"Jam!" Leo grinned.

"Yes!" Aunt Rosa wrote. "Step three: Jam. And last?"

"Top bread!" they shouted.

Aunt Rosa beamed. "That’s a super-smart plan! Steps in the best order! Ready?"

They nodded. Bottom bread down. Leo added cheese. Fern spread jam, not a drop spilled! Top bread on. Two perfect Super Snack Sandwiches!

"Wow!" breathed Fern. "It worked! So neat!"

Leo held up a sandwich. "Tidy! And we made them quickly!" He took a bite. "Yummy!"

Aunt Rosa winked. "That's the magic of a plan! It helps us build things, step by step."

Leo grinned, jam on his nose. "A plan is a super-smart guide!"

"Precisely!" said Aunt Rosa. "Now you're planning experts!"

Leo munched happily. "Fantastic! What else can we build with a plan?"

Fern nudged him. "Our science experiment!"

Aunt Rosa laughed. "Discovery is just beginning! There are smart plans everywhere!"

With a big grin, Leo and Fern grabbed their sandwiches, ready to race to science club, minds buzzing with plans. "Today," Leo declared, taking another bite, "is going to be AMAZING!"
characters: Leo the marble racer, Fern the fawn, Aunt Rosa
